== Editing the family navigator ==
This shared navigator appears in the Versions infobox of each article in the Dagobah [[Knowledge And Defense]] family. To update membership, use the '''Edit versions''' link on a member article or edit this template's source. Each publication entry uses [[Template:Card version link]] with its canonical article title and concise visible label.

Add a verified publication here once and include <code><nowiki>{{Card versions/Knowledge And Defense (Dagobah)}}</nowiki></code> in its card template's <code>versions</code> field. Keep its existing images, text and identity.

Membership is every verified existing article in this Dagobah family. Follow [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Card infobox Versions (Bill, 2026-10-26)|the card-family rules]], including the official AI/ALT exception. Reflections Gold same-name/different-picture cards are a separate lineage. Virtual headings follow each article's |set=. Do not invent printings.
Modern Set 0 is ordered by the verified publication evidence: the original text (attested by the 2016 slip), the changed text (2017 slip / 2018 full card), the same-text PC Remastered face (2022), then the official alternate image (2025). The 2017 slip and 2018 full card are one logical version with both existing destinations retained. The 2022 face changes presentation and the margin mark from E to E1, not gameplay text; it is not another text erratum. Dates here attest the copies, not necessarily their first release. 

</noinclude>
